sourceDoors.label: KINSHIP-006: signed Jubilee public-need history -> HELD neighbor-help producer candidate (draft / not adopted)
KINSHIP-007: local Living Gifts gallery and separate scoped media consent (draft / not adopted)
Static Live owning code and Kinship-local Fall Share Room
Existing Kinship Radio calendar and official event-announcement submission invitation
Existing station-owned volunteer and ambassador structure, not available volunteer labor

mediaDoors.proposal: Potential independently authorized public-event notice, if the store/group invites an announcement and Kinship accepts it.
preconditions: Event actually exists, public details approved by actual host
Organizer grants consent and supplies a public contact
Official station calendar submission/review rules followed

mediaDoors.proposal: POTENTIAL recurring radio card-bulletin: a station producer periodically selects a freshly revalidated, separate-radio-consented snapshot of current source-owned public help cards. Listeners open the CURRENT online card for an optional safe response; local stewards update need status, with independent recipient confirmation; Kinship chooses whether and when to broadcast.
preconditions: No money-only, private prayer, or sensitive beneficiary data
Actual need owner grants current, scoped publication consent
Human checks freshness, safety, service area and safe response route
Radio producer performs independent station-owned editorial review
Aired status is documented by Kinship, not inferred from a compiled pack
Recipient separately confirms any actual help
Every edition is a dated snapshot; recheck current source status and radio permission before any intended air
Stable current-state online route remains useful after a card is fulfilled, paused, expired or withdrawn
Responding online never assigns volunteer work or proves need fulfillment

mediaDoors.proposal: Optionally share a permissioned non-identifying account of a real pilot, with independent audio/story/broadcast rights.
preconditions: Original activity documented and independently reviewed
No beneficiary story publication inferred from help confirmation
Station editor independently approves any production/broadcast

adapterConcept.source: The local grocery/commons steward owns source information; optional Jubilee Treasury may preserve eligible owner-signed public-need references.
adapterConcept.bridge: Human-curated publicly safe candidate, and only for eligible neighbor-help items an eventual KINSHIP-006 compatible held producer pack. No software handshake assumed.
adapterConcept.receiver: Kinship station-side editor/producer retains final editorial judgment, program scheduling, own contacts and policies.
adapterConcept.return: The proposing group may receive station-approved outcome feedback; volunteers and beneficiary receipts remain at their owners. No broadcast proof without station witness.
nonClaims: Listener interest is not a donation/consent
Owner signature is not beneficiary verification

firstProof: Synthetic rotating card feed: station chooses a mock dated edition, source changes/withdraws/fills a need, listener offer remains unassigned, current page changes, next edition excludes stale or fulfilled need. No sending, live intake or air.
primaryProposition: Station-selected periodic broadcast of steward-maintained currently actionable public-safe cards; listeners use an owner-approved online card door to respond; source changes determine the next edition.

rotatingBroadcast.broadcastMechanic: Human-selected dated snapshot of currently actionable cards, not automatically updating FM audio
rotatingBroadcast.responseMechanic: Recipient or volunteer voluntarily opens currently valid public card and sends offer to source-owning steward, not to station
rotatingBroadcast.stalePolicy: Expired, changed, consent-revoked or unverified cards omitted from newly generated editions; producer rechecks before real air; old public card URL shows current state.
rotatingBroadcast.proofGate: A fictional card can change status, be excluded from the next mock edition, and return a synthetic non-assignment response; no real world claims.
